organizations.publicNote: Linked discographic sources identify Gloria as a German-market record label in the Lindström group.

sources.shortCitation: Gloria G-10027 a, “Ich steh im Schnee und wart auf dich”
sources.fullCitation: Gloria-Tanz-Orchester mit Refraingesang. “Ich steh im Schnee und wart auf dich.” Fox-trot; label credit “Kaper–Rotter–Robinson”. Gloria, Bestell-Nr. G-10027 a, marked “Nur für Deutschland”. Disc label shown in the YouTube transfer published by Brillantspecial.
sources.title: Ich steh im Schnee und wart auf dich — Gloria G-10027 a
sources.creator: Gloria-Tanz-Orchester; John Hendrik, vocal
sources.researchNote: The displayed label identifies Gloria G-10027 a, the Gloria-Tanz-Orchester with vocal refrain and the credit “Kaper–Rotter–Robinson”. It does not name the singer or conductor. The upload identifies John Hendrik and Otto Dobrindt and gives 30 January 1931 as the recording date; those details are not established by the label. No matrix number is legible on the displayed label.

sources.shortCitation: Gloria G.O. 10197, “Wer weint heut’ aus Liebe Tränen?”
sources.fullCitation: Melody Gents, modernes Schlager-Quartett mit Orchester. “Wer weint heut’ aus Liebe Tränen?” Slowfox from Ehe mit beschränkter Haftung; label credits music to Dr. B. Kaper and W. Jurmann, arrangement to Rud. Goehr and words to Fritz Rotter. Gloria G.O. 10197 b, printed matrix Bi 412. Disc label shown in the YouTube transfer published by Ilja Livschakoff.
sources.title: Wer weint heut’ aus Liebe Tränen? — Gloria G.O. 10197
sources.creator: Melody Gents, modernes Schlager-Quartett mit Orchester
sources.researchNote: The displayed Gloria label identifies G.O. 10197 b, matrix Bi 412, the Melody Gents with orchestra, the composers, lyricist and arranger “Rud. Goehr”. The year 1932 appears in the video title without specifying a recording or issue date; it remains a reported date of the described item. The label does not identify a recording session or a take.

sources.shortCitation: Gloria G.O. 10155, “Mondnacht in Sanssouci” (Eric Harden with John Hendrik, 1931)
sources.fullCitation: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester, refrain sung by John Hendrik. “Mondnacht in Sanssouci.” Gloria G.O. 10155, matrix Bi 80, recorded 29 April 1931. Title list at musiktiteldb.de, compiled by Henry König from discographic and trade sources.
sources.title: Mondnacht in Sanssouci — Gloria G.O. 10155
sources.creator: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester; John Hendrik, refrain vocal
sources.researchNote: The title-list entry gives 29 April 1931 as the recording date and leaves the release-date column empty. The structured date therefore identifies the session, not the commercial issue of Gloria G.O. 10155. No publicly accessible transfer of this disc was located during the recording-link audit.

sources.shortCitation: Pfau, Lexikon der deutschen Tanzmusik, vol. 4 (1998), pp. 451–452
sources.fullCitation: H. Pfau. Lexikon der deutschen Tanzmusik 1925–1945. Band 4: Foxtrott u.ä., H–Ich. Leverkusen, 1998, pp. 451–452. DOI 10.22032/dbt.57689.
sources.title: Ich geh’ nie von dir fort — discographic entry
sources.creator: H. Pfau
sources.researchNote: The entry identifies the song as a 1933 Austrian foxtrot from the film released in Germany as “Madame wünscht keine Kinder”, credits the music to Walter Jurmann and Dr. B. Kaper and the words to Fritz Rotter and Max Kolpe, and lists two commercial issues: Artiphon 8489 by Eddy Walis and Gloria G.O. 10725 by Fred Bird.

sources.shortCitation: Gloria G.O. 10303, “Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen” (1932)
sources.fullCitation: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester, refrain sung by Carljohann Volbach. “Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen!” From Melodie der Liebe; music by Walter Jurmann and Bronislaw Kaper, words by Fritz Rotter. Gloria G.O. 10303, matrix Bi 644. Recorded in Berlin, studio 4, 11 June 1932; issued November 1932. Title-list entry at Musiktiteldb.de, citing Discographie der deutschen Tanzmusik, vol. 8.
sources.title: Wie gern möcht’ ich dich verwöhnen — Gloria G.O. 10303
sources.creator: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester; Carljohann Volbach, refrain vocal
sources.researchNote: The title-list entry distinguishes the recording session (Berlin, studio 4, 11 June 1932) from the Gloria issue (November 1932). This source documents Gloria G.O. 10303 specifically. The Internet Archive transfer numbered D 4431 reports the same matrix, Bi 644, but does not identify its issuing label or date; the Gloria imprint and November issue date are not assigned to that pressing. No second listening reference is created.

contributions.scopeNote: The displayed disc bears the Gloria label and catalogue number G.O. 10197 b.

Gloria issued the recording as G.O. 10303 in November 1932, matrix Bi 644, recorded in Berlin on 11 June 1932. This credit concerns that German issue, not the separately transferred pressing D 4431, whose issuing label and date remain unidentified.
Issued the Fred Bird recording as Gloria G.O. 10725.
